body:
> I verified that I'm using a C# distribution of Godot, which doesn't require any additional installs

C# distributions **DO** need the additional install of the .NET SDK (not only .NET, but the SDK) as stated in the download page : 
> Additional requirements for the .NET version:
> [.NET SDK](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download)

For Godot 4.2, use .NET version 6.0 (but I think version 8.0 works as well)
We could improve this message to instruct this somehow, but otherwise this is already documented as a requirement to use C#

The message `Unable to find the .NET assemblies directory` should only show up if the GodotSharp DLLs directory can't be found:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/2213545fc55e0ab5cf8c737d70a6ad1fc52e17ed/modules/mono/mono_gd/gd_mono.cpp#L530-L533

I don't know why Godot can't find the GodotSharp DLLs directory if the directory exists, I would assume `DirAccess::exists` would return `true`. I don't use macOS myself, but I know macOS users that don't seem to have this problem, so I don't know why it fails in your case.

There's another message that shows up if the issue is we couldn't load the .NET runtime, and that message does instruct you to install the .NET SDK:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/2213545fc55e0ab5cf8c737d70a6ad1fc52e17ed/modules/mono/mono_gd/gd_mono.cpp#L556
Try moving `Godot_mono.app` to another folder, `get_api_assemblies_dir` might have issues with Gatekeeper path randomization.

My bad, I was reading instructions as well that say I should just extract and run - sorry I installed .NET 6 and 8 SDKs as well but I'm still getting the same message. Reboot after installation didn't help as well. I moved the `Godot_mono.app` around different folders and it didn't help too.

#### Reproduction Success > Godot 4.4 Mac @MM263, I am able to consistently reproduce this outside of macOS; instead, on Windows 11 Pro 24H2, and with `pwsh`'s `Invoke-Expression` commandlet (AKA `&`) *and* `cmd`: - #### Error 1. ~~~pwsh #!/usr/bin/env pwsh #Requires -PSEdition Core #Requires -Version 7.6.0 If ($IsWindows) { Invoke-Expression "$Home\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Links\godot.exe" } ~~~ 1.
~~~YAML PS C:\Users\rokej> Invoke-Expression "$Home\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Links\godot.exe" PS C:\Users\rokej> Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.mono.official.49a5bc7b6 - https://godotengine.org OpenGL API 3.3.0 Core Profile Context 24.6.1.240619 - Compatibility - Using Device: ATI Technologies Inc. - AMD Radeon RX 5700 ERROR: .NET: Assemblies not found at: (modules/mono/mono_gd/gd_mono.cpp:530) ~~~
However, it reproducibly *doesn't* occur with `pwsh`'s `Start-Process`: 1. ~~~pwsh #!/usr/bin/env pwsh #Requires -PSEdition Core #Requires -Version 7.6.0 If ($IsWindows) { Start-Process "$Home\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Links\godot.exe" } ~~~ 1.
~~~pwsh PS C:\Users\rokej> Start-Process "$Home\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Links\godot.exe" PS C:\Users\rokej> Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.mono.official.49a5bc7b6 - https://godotengine.org OpenGL API 3.3.0 Core Profile Context 24.6.1.240619 - Compatibility - Using Device: ATI Technologies Inc. - AMD Radeon RX 5700 ~~~
- #### Environment - #### OS 1. ~~~pwsh #!/usr/bin/env pwsh #Requires -PSEdition Core #Requires -Version 7.6.0 If ($IsWindows) { Get-ComputerInfo | Select-Object -Property @( 'OsName', 'OsOperatingSystemSKU', 'OsVersion', 'OsBuildNumber' ) | Format-List } ~~~ 1.
~~~YAML OsName : Microsoft Windows 11 Pro OsOperatingSystemSKU : 48 OsVersion : 10.0.26120 OsBuildNumber : 26120 ~~~
- #### Package 1. ~~~pwsh #!/usr/bin/env pwsh #Requires -PSEdition Core #Requires -Version 7.6.0 If ($IsWindows) { Get-WinGetPackage -Query GodotEngine.GodotEngine.Mono | Select-Object @( 'InstalledVersion', 'IsUpdateAvailable', 'Source' ) | Format-List } ~~~ 1.
~~~YAML InstalledVersion : 4.4.1 IsUpdateAvailable : False Source : winget ~~~
I encountered this whilst attempting to debug https://github.com/microsoft/winget-pkgs/discussions/270968#discussioncomment-13778527. #### Reproduction Failure For comparison, I am unable to reproduce it on `godot-4.4.1-2.fc42.x86_64`, on the same hardware: - 1. ~~~sh #!/usr/bin/env sh godot ~~~ 1.
~~~Markdown Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.fedora.49a5bc7b6 - https://godotengine.org OpenGL API 4.6 (Core Profile) Mesa 25.1.4 - Compatibility - Using Device: AMD - AMD Radeon RX 5700 (radeonsi, navi10, LLVM 20.1.7, DRM 3.63, 6.15.5-200.fc42.x86_64) ~~~
- 1. ~~~sh #!/usr/bin/env sh rpm -qa | grep dotnet ~~~ 1.
~~~ASM dotnet-host-9.0.6-1.fc42.x86_64 dotnet-apphost-pack-9.0-9.0.6-1.fc42.x86_64 dotnet-hostfxr-9.0-9.0.6-1.fc42.x86_64 dotnet-runtime-9.0-9.0.6-1.fc42.x86_64 dotnet-targeting-pack-9.0-9.0.6-1.fc42.x86_64 dotnet-templates-9.0-9.0.107-1.fc42.x86_64 dotnet-sdk-9.0-9.0.107-1.fc42.x86_64 ~~~
